text:
kevin: Heads up: post-deploy telemetry flagged a memory growth regression on canary (eu). Auto-rollback trending, but we have customers on dedicated nodes in the same region. Holding auto-revert and triage.

deploy-bot: CANARY MEM ALERT: mem.rss growth +28% over baseline. Auto-rollback scheduled in 6m unless acknowledged. metric=mem.rss, slice=eu-canary

nora: Acknowledge. Hold auto-rollback. Suggest a hotfix rollback to the agent that reverts the memory-related change only (small patch). Avoid full version revert if possible.

sylvie: Agree with hotfix. I have a minimal revert patch (id: 2026-04-memfix). Jordan, can you verify this cherry-pick and get PR ready?

ops-runner: Preparing rollback steps: snapshot, drain one host, apply hotfix build, bring back. Command sequence: `deployctl drain --host eu-canary-03; deployctl promote --host eu-canary-03 --version v2.9.1-hotfix --preserve-schema; deployctl uncordon --host eu-canary-03`. Will run serially to minimize blast radius.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback paused by user kevin.

support-lead: I'll draft a short line for customers in case they notice performance blips. Keep it minimal.

kevin: Execute hotfix rollback on 3 canary hosts sequentially. Monitor memory graphs and error rates. If mem continues rising after hotfix, escalate to full rollback.

ops-runner: Hotfix applied to 1/3 hosts. mem usage dropped on that host within 2m. Proceeding with hosts 2 and 3.

deploy-bot: promote_job=prom-4945-88 target_hosts=3 progress=33%

ops-runner: Hotfix applied to all 3 canary hosts. mem graphs show regression mitigated. No increase in error rates.

nora: Great. Keep canary paused for 20m before resuming ramp. Add note to release notes: "Hotfix applied to canary to address mem growth; monitoring ongoing."

support-lead: Customer note sent: "We've applied a minor mitigation to today's rollout to improve memory usage in the EU region. No action required. We'll follow up with details in the post-mortem."

kevin: Closing bridge; monitoring in background. We'll file a follow-up to adjust auto-rollback conditions to prefer hotfixes before full reverts when customers present.

sylvie: PR #8802 opened for hotfix cherry-pick. Includes smoke tests and memory profiles.

ops-runner: Bridge closed +35m. No regressions observed.

kevin: Thanks team. Add a short runbook note for sequential hotfix rollbacks in canary to minimize customer impact. :white_check_mark:
